anchors: The between-visit monitoring gap is the structural reason BP goes uncontrolled. Most hypertensive patients are seen 2-3 times a year; everything in between is largely invisible.
$100-120 per hypertensive patient per month via CPT 99457 and 99458, plus the new 2026 codes 99445 and 99470 that make remote BP reimbursement materially easier to capture.
Two things kill remote monitoring programs: Bluetooth devices patients cannot pair, and troubleshooting that lands on staff. 4G cellular devices that transmit automatically remove both failure modes.
Approximately 120 million Americans have hypertension. Only about 24 percent have BP under control. Uncontrolled hypertension costs the US healthcare system about $131 billion per year.

30 days to fully running. No upfront cost. 20 minutes per patient per month of clinician time. The practice approves enrollment and does a monthly review; Cardiowell handles devices, shipping, onboarding, monitoring, billing support, and auto-generated documentation.
